text: よしッ　どーんと　ぶつかって　こい！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て form says the action moves toward the speaker; こい is its blunt order form. ぶつかって こい = 'come crashing at me!'.

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a sound word tells in what way the action is done. どーんと = 'with a bang', meaning with full force.
